indexes.//: Nearby black spot lookup. The repository filters on verified + active and then range-scans geohash, so the composite index must order the equality fields before the range field. Without this the query fails at runtime with a FAILED_PRECONDITION.

The My Reports screen: a user's own reports, newest first. The equality field precedes the ordered field, which is what Firestore requires; without this the query fails at runtime with a FAILED_PRECONDITION.
Moderation queue (Phase 7): pending reports oldest first, so the longest-waiting report is reviewed next.
A user reading back their own alert history, newest first (Phase 11 / 13).
